caption:
Your rule breaches. Every pending order cancels immediately.

When a preset threshold triggers, KaatDo cancels every pending order and squares off every position at market. The account stays locked until close. If trading activity reappears, the system re-fires.

Execution runs server-side on six brokers: Fyers, Upstox, Zerodha, Angel One, Dhan and Groww, using official trade APIs.

kaatdo.com

KaatDo is a risk-management technology tool, not investment advice, and is not registered with SEBI. Broker API execution is never guaranteed.
